commits.message:
Add agentic issue-triage workflow (gh-aw) (#374)

* Add agentic issue-triage workflow (gh-aw)

Adds a GitHub Agentic Workflow that triages issues labeled
`triage-for-agent`: classify (bug/feature/documentation/question/other),
assess the claim against the code by reading only, enrich with the likely
rule + file:line and related issues, and post one advisory triage comment.

Security model:
- Trust gate: fires only on the `labeled` event for `triage-for-agent`
  applied by an actor with write/maintain/admin (roles) — anonymous or
  attacker-authored issues never auto-trigger it.
- Powerless agent: read-only permissions; the comment is posted by a
  separate privileged safe-outputs job.
- threat-detection scans the proposed comment for prompt injection /
  secret leaks before posting (fail-closed).
- Egress pinned to GitHub + OpenRouter; actions SHA-pinned.

Model: GLM 5.2 via OpenRouter using the Copilot engine's BYOK mode. The
only secret is OPENROUTER_API_KEY; gh-aw excludes the provider key from
the agent container so a compromised agent cannot read or exfiltrate it.

The runnable issue-triage.lock.yml is generated from issue-triage.md via
`gh aw compile`; see .github/workflows/README.md.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Reuse skillsaw-issue-review skill from the triage workflow

The triage procedure now lives in the skillsaw-issue-review skill, which
Copilot auto-discovers from .agents/skills/. The workflow body just invokes it,
so the same skill (with its progressive-disclosure references/) is reusable
interactively too — no duplicated triage logic.

- Add the skillsaw-issue-review skill (SKILL.md + references/) plus its
  apm-generated .claude/.agents copies.
- Broaden bug evaluation: trace a bug to the responsible code (a rule, or the
  lint tree / markdown_doc / config / autofix / CLI), not only rules.
- Reduce the workflow body to a single skill invocation; the sandbox
  (read-only perms, firewall, safe-outputs, threat-detection) stays in the
  frontmatter.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Rename skillsaw-issue-review skill to skillsaw-issue-triage

"Triage" matches what the skill does. Renames the source, regenerated
.claude/.agents copies, the workflow's skill invocation, the compiled lock,
the workflow README, and the skill's own self-reference in the triage template.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

md_changes.file_patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,51 @@
+---
+# skillsaw issue triage (GitHub Agentic Workflow — requires `gh aw compile`)
+#
+# Security model (see THREAT_MODEL.md and the gh-aw threat-detection reference):
+#   - Trust gate: only fires when a maintainer applies the `triage-for-agent`
+#     label (labeled event + names filter + roles gate). Anonymous/attacker
+#     issues never auto-trigger the agent.
+#   - Powerless agent: `permissions: read-all` — the agent that reads the
+#     untrusted issue text cannot write anything.
+#   - Privilege separation: the triage comment is posted by the `safe-outputs`
+#     job, not the agent. `threat-detection` (auto-enabled by safe-outputs)
+#     scans the proposed comment for prompt_injection / secret_leak before it
+#     is posted, fail-closed.
+#   - Egress is pinned to GitHub + OpenRouter.
+on:
+  issues:
+    types: [labeled]
+    names: [triage-for-agent]      # only this maintainer-applied label
+  roles: [admin, maintainer, write] # only a trusted actor's label fires it
+  reaction: "eyes"                  # bot 👀s the issue when it picks it up
+
+permissions: read-all               # powerless agent — no write scope
+
+timeout-minutes: 10
+
+network:
+  allowed:
+    - defaults                      # GitHub, package registries
+    - openrouter.ai                 # model API egress
+
+# Run GLM 5.2 through OpenRouter via Copilot BYOK. These COPILOT_PROVIDER_*
+# vars are the ONLY secret-carrying engine.env keys gh-aw strict mode allows —
+# the provider key is handed to the model layer, not exposed to the agent
+# container, so a compromised agent cannot read or exfiltrate it.
+engine:
+  id: copilot
+  env:
+    COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
+    COPILOT_PROVIDER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
+    COPILOT_MODEL: z-ai/glm-5.2
+
+safe-outputs:
+  add-comment:                      # posted by the privileged safe-output job
+  threat-detection: true            # scan agent output before posting (default when safe-outputs is set)
+---
+
+# skillsaw Issue Triage
+
+A maintainer has labeled the triggering issue `triage-for-agent`. Triage that
+issue using the **skillsaw-issue-triage** skill, and post the triage comment it
+produces.

commits.message:
Triage: Copilot + Opus, redesigned template, drop OpenRouter (#376)

* Triage: switch to Copilot + Opus, redesign template, strip OpenRouter

- Engine: drop the OpenRouter BYOK. The GLM 5.2 slug never engaged — the run
  silently fell back to Copilot's default model. Use Copilot's hosted model
  directly, pinned to claude-opus-4.8. Removes the OPENROUTER_API_KEY dependency
  and the openrouter.ai egress.
- Template: recommendation-first — 🛠️ FIX / ✨ IMPLEMENT / 🔌 PLUGIN / ⛔ REJECT
  as the headline, a one-line verdict, a 3–4 sentence summary, and collapsed
  details.
- feature-evaluation: lead with a domain gate so out-of-domain asks (e.g.
  linting a programming language) resolve to REJECT, not a mis-routed PLUGIN.
- Auto-remove the triage-for-agent label once the comment is posted
  (remove-labels safe-output).
- Wire the recommendation vocabulary through SKILL.md and the eval checklists;
  fix the stale "Issue Review" heading.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Sync .claude skill copy (apm partial-propagation fix for verify-apm)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Triage: address review feedback + match review-panel style

- Template: adopt the review-panel verdict style (verdict-led with a bold
  Recommendation, --- separators, collapsed details). Drop the Classification
  and Basis fields entirely — the FIX/IMPLEMENT/PLUGIN/REJECT recommendation
  already carries that, which also removes the basis-legend mismatch CodeRabbit
  and Gemini flagged.
- Resolve the SKILL.md ↔ workflow label contradiction (Devin): the skill no
  longer issues a blanket "don't label" that fights the workflow's trigger-label
  removal — it now allows a label action the invoking context explicitly directs.
- Drop leftover "basis:" prose in the eval checklists.
- Remove the engine comment that described an absent secret.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.message:
Fix Copilot auth in triage workflow: grant copilot-requests permission (#379)

The triage workflow's Copilot engine failed activation at 'Validate
COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN secret' because no COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN secret is set.
Copilot's default auth uses the job GITHUB_TOKEN carrying the copilot-requests
scope instead. Convert permissions from read-all to an explicit read map plus
copilot-requests: write.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

claude-opus-4.8 returns '400 model not supported' — on Copilot Free/Student the

lets Copilot pick a supported model (as the first successful run did by default).

commits.message:
Triage: set Copilot model to auto (Free/Student tiers can't pin a model) (#383)

Omitting model let gh-aw fall back to its default (claude-sonnet-4.6), which is
still an explicit pin and returns '400 model not supported' on tiers that only
allow auto model selection. Setting model: auto emits COPILOT_MODEL=auto so
Copilot picks a supported model itself.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.message:
Triage: BYOK to OpenRouter (GLM 5.2) via Copilot provider vars (#385)

Copilot's own model catalog can't be self-selected on this tier (opus, sonnet,
and auto all fail). Route model requests to OpenRouter instead via the
COPILOT_PROVIDER_* BYOK vars (strict-mode allowed), so the model is validated by
OpenRouter, not Copilot. Restores openrouter.ai egress.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.message:
Triage: allow PyPI egress so the agent can actually run skillsaw (#386)

* Triage: allow PyPI egress so the agent can actually run skillsaw

The bug-evaluation step tells the agent to reproduce by running skillsaw, but
without PyPI it can't pip install skillsaw — so it would infer results from
reading the code and format them as if it ran. Add the 'python' network
ecosystem (pypi.org + files.pythonhosted.org) so reproduction is real.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Triage: accurate egress header comment (address Devin review)

Keep the 'python' network ecosystem (gh-aw's recommended identifier) rather than
listing pypi.org/files.pythonhosted.org by hand. Update the security-model
header, which still claimed egress was pinned to GitHub only, to list all three
categories: GitHub/Copilot API, OpenRouter (BYOK), and PyPI.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.message:
Consolidate agent labels and rename workflows (#447)

* Consolidate agent labels and rename workflows

Unify issue-for-agent and pr-for-agent into a single "agent" label,
rename triage-for-agent to "triage", rename workflows to "Issue Solver"
and "PR Follow-up", and add ultracode label support for --effort ultracode.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Run each issue in its own Claude session via matrix strategy

Split the issue solver into a discover job (collects labeled issues) and
a solve matrix job (one independent Claude session per issue). Also
updates the skill wording from plural to singular to match.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Run each PR follow-up in its own Claude session via matrix strategy

Split the PR follow-up into a discover job (collects labeled PRs and
their comments) and a follow-up matrix job (one independent Claude
session per PR). Also updates the skill wording to singular.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Fix jq quoting bug in PR comment filtering

Shell string concatenation produced a stray space in the endswith
suffix, so comment filtering never matched any PR. Use jq string
concatenation ("/" + $num) instead.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
